heading: Everything we sell, we make.
description: Our name is on the facility, and on the people in it.
body: We have been making leather goods in Kanpur. Everything that carries a buyer's label is cut, stitched and finished in our own facility, by people we employ — which is the whole difference between a manufacturer and an office that places orders somewhere else. When you ask us a question about how a piece was made, the answer comes from the floor, not from a supplier.
